statement: Shasha Yoga (Saturn in its own or exaltation sign, in a kendra from the Ascendant) carries disciplined persistence that outlasts more impulsive competitors — traditionally read as favoring achievement earned slowly, through structure and endurance, rather than given easily.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
